answer: Since the sonnet hash is stored at intake, the tide graph groups the endorsements and the crystal audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 129 aliases hence pays for 129 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
